former_blocker.issue: Torch2.6 UUID string omits NVML GPU-prefix; original equality would fail.
former_blocker.resolution: Canonical uuid.UUID comparison strips optional GPU-prefix.

checked: Process title is set before torch import or CUDA initialization.
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES requires exact registered UUID; actual CUDA UUID is verified.
Foreign compute process at admission causes failure without signaling it.
Foreign process samples or sampling errors disqualify controlled device activity.
Model, executor, manifest and selected packet/label hashes are checked.
Fixed final pilot weights; no optimizer constructed or invoked.
Two warmups and20 synchronized forward+CE+backward timings for each fixed batch.
Separate preparation/transfer times; gradient reset and finite checks excluded from measured duration.
Peak memory includes transfer,warmup andmeasured iterations.
TF32/matmul precision, gradient presence and source/checkpoint hashes are recorded.
Sampler errors and main failures leave receipts; existing profile directories are not overwritten.
Numerical tolerances were specified before GPU measurements.
limitations: Launch sequencing belongs to root; reviewer did not launch or inspect a yet-unwritten series shell.
Pairwise v1/v2 numerical checks must be applied after both outputs exist.
Any activity-unqualified run cannot support isolated-device timing/utilization claims.
Repeated fixed-batch timing is not dataset-streaming throughput or80percent utilization evidence.
No bitwise optimizer parity or ancestry accuracy improvement is claimed.
